record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Moses<WH04872>, Go<WH0935><WTH8798> unto Pharaoh<WH06547>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto him, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, Let my people<WH05971> go<WH07971><WTH8761>, that they may serve<WH05647><WTH8799> me.
And if thou refuse<WH03986> to let <FI>them<Fi> go<WH07971><WTH8763>, behold, I will smite<WH05062><WTH8802> all thy borders<WH01366> with frogs<WH06854>:

And the river<WH02975> shall bring forth<WH08317><WH00> frogs<WH06854> abundantly<WH08317><WTH8804>, which shall go up<WH05927><WTH8804> and come<WH0935><WTH8804> into thine house<WH01004>, and into thy bedchamber<WH02315><WH04904>, and upon thy bed<WH04296>, and into the house<WH01004> of thy servants<WH05650>, and upon thy people<WH05971>, and into thine ovens<WH08574>, and into thy kneadingtroughs<WH04863>: <RF>kneadingtroughs: or, dough<Rf>
And the frogs<WH06854> shall come up<WH05927><WTH8799> both on thee, and upon thy people<WH05971>, and upon all thy servants<WH05650>.

And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Moses<WH04872>, Say<WH0559><WTH8798> unto Aaron<WH0175>, Stretch forth<WH05186><WTH8798> thine hand<WH03027> with thy rod<WH04294> over the streams<WH05104>, over the rivers<WH02975>, and over the ponds<WH098>, and cause frogs<WH06854> to come up<WH05927><WTH8685> upon the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>.

And Aaron<WH0175> stretched out<WH05186><WTH8799> his hand<WH03027> over the waters<WH04325> of Egypt<WH04714>; and the frogs<WH06854> came up<WH05927><WTH8799>, and covered<WH03680><WTH8762> the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>.
And the magicians<WH02748> did<WH06213><WTH8799> so with their enchantments<WH03909>, and brought up<WH05927><WTH8686> frogs<WH06854> upon the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>.

Then Pharaoh<WH06547> called<WH07121><WTH8799> for Moses<WH04872> and Aaron<WH0175>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Intreat<WH06279><WTH8685> the LORD<WH03068>, that he may take away<WH05493><WTH8686> the frogs<WH06854> from me, and from my people<WH05971>; and I will let the people<WH05971> go<WH07971><WTH8762>, that they may do sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8799> unto the LORD<WH03068>.

And Moses<WH04872> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Pharaoh<WH06547>, Glory<WH06286><WTH8690> over me: when<WH04970> shall I intreat<WH06279><WTH8686> for thee, and for thy servants<WH05650>, and for thy people<WH05971>, to destroy<WH03772><WTH8687> the frogs<WH06854> from thee and thy houses<WH01004>, <FI>that<Fi> they may remain<WH07604><WTH8735> in the river<WH02975> only? <RF>Glory...: or, Have this honour over me, etc<Rf> <RF>when: or, against when<Rf> <RF>to destroy: Heb. to cut off<Rf>

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, To morrow<WH04279>. And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>Be it<Fi> according to thy word<WH01697>: that thou mayest know<WH03045><WTH8799> that <FI>there is<Fi> none like unto the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430>. <RF>To morrow: or, Against to morrow<Rf>

And the frogs<WH06854> shall depart<WH05493><WTH8804> from thee, and from thy houses<WH01004>, and from thy servants<WH05650>, and from thy people<WH05971>; they shall remain<WH07604><WTH8735> in the river<WH02975> only.

And Moses<WH04872> and Aaron<WH0175> went out<WH03318><WTH8799> from Pharaoh<WH06547>: and Moses<WH04872> cried<WH06817><WTH8799> unto the LORD<WH03068> because of<WH01697> the frogs<WH06854> which he had brought<WH07760><WTH8804> against Pharaoh<WH06547>.

And the LORD<WH03068> did<WH06213><WTH8799> according to the word<WH01697> of Moses<WH04872>; and the frogs<WH06854> died<WH04191><WTH8799> out of the houses<WH01004>, out of the villages<WH02691>, and out of the fields<WH07704>.
And they gathered them together<WH06651><WTH8799> upon heaps<WH02563>: and the land<WH0776> stank<WH0887><WTH8799>.

But when Pharaoh<WH06547> saw<WH07200><WTH8799> that there was respite<WH07309>, he hardened<WH03513><WTH8687> his heart<WH03820>, and hearkened<WH08085><WTH8804> not unto them; as the LORD<WH03068> had said<WH01696><WTH8765>.<CM>

And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Moses<WH04872>, Say<WH0559><WTH8798> unto Aaron<WH0175>, Stretch out<WH05186><WTH8798> thy rod<WH04294>, and smite<WH05221><WTH8685> the dust<WH06083> of the land<WH0776>, that it may become lice<WH03654> throughout all the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>.

And they did<WH06213><WTH8799> so; for Aaron<WH0175> stretched out<WH05186><WTH8799> his hand<WH03027> with his rod<WH04294>, and smote<WH05221><WTH8686> the dust<WH06083> of the earth<WH0776>, and it became lice<WH03654> in man<WH0120>, and in beast<WH0929>; all the dust<WH06083> of the land<WH0776> became lice<WH03654> throughout all the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>.

And the magicians<WH02748> did<WH06213><WTH8799> so with their enchantments<WH03909> to bring forth<WH03318><WTH8687> lice<WH03654>, but they could<WH03201><WTH8804> not: so there were lice<WH03654> upon man<WH0120>, and upon beast<WH0929>.

Then the magicians<WH02748> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Pharaoh<WH06547>, This <FI>is<Fi> the finger<WH0676> of God<WH0430>: and Pharaoh's<WH06547> heart<WH03820> was hardened<WH02388><WTH8799>, and he hearkened<WH08085><WTH8804> not unto them; as the LORD<WH03068> had said<WH01696><WTH8765>.<CM>

And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Moses<WH04872>, Rise up early<WH07925><WTH8685> in the morning<WH01242>, and stand<WH03320><WTH8690> before<WH06440> Pharaoh<WH06547>; lo, he cometh forth<WH03318><WTH8802> to the water<WH04325>; and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto him, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, Let my people<WH05971> go<WH07971><WTH8761>, that they may serve<WH05647><WTH8799> me.

Else, if thou wilt not let my people<WH05971> go<WH07971><WTH8764>, behold, I will send<WH07971><WTH8688> swarms<WH06157> <FI>of flies<Fi> upon thee, and upon thy servants<WH05650>, and upon thy people<WH05971>, and into thy houses<WH01004>: and the houses<WH01004> of the Egyptians<WH04714> shall be full<WH04390><WTH8804> of swarms<WH06157> <FI>of flies<Fi> , and also the ground<WH0127> whereon they <FI>are<Fi> . <RF>swarms...: or, a mixture of noisome beasts, etc<Rf>

And I will sever<WH06395><WTH8689> in that day<WH03117> the land<WH0776> of Goshen<WH01657>, in which my people<WH05971> dwell<WH05975><WTH8802>, that no<WH01115> swarms<WH06157> <FI>of flies<Fi> shall be<WH01961><WTH8800> there; to the end<WH04616> thou mayest know<WH03045><WTH8799> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> in the midst<WH07130> of the earth<WH0776>.

And I will put<WH07760><WTH8804> a division<WH06304> between my people<WH05971> and thy people<WH05971>: to morrow<WH04279> shall this sign<WH0226> be. <RF>a division: Heb. a redemption<Rf> <RF>to morrow: or, by to morrow<Rf>

And the LORD<WH03068> did<WH06213><WTH8799> so; and there came<WH0935><WTH8799> a grievous<WH03515> swarm<WH06157> <FI>of flies<Fi> into the house<WH01004> of Pharaoh<WH06547>, and <FI>into<Fi> his servants<WH05650>' houses<WH01004>, and into all the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>: the land<WH0776> was corrupted<WH07843><WTH8735> by reason<WH06440> of the swarm<WH06157> <FI>of flies<Fi> . <RF>corrupted: or, destroyed<Rf>

And Pharaoh<WH06547> called<WH07121><WTH8799> for<WH0413> Moses<WH04872> and for Aaron<WH0175>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Go<WH03212><WTH8798> ye, sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8798> to your God<WH0430> in the land<WH0776>.

And Moses<WH04872> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, It is not meet<WH03559><WTH8737> so to do<WH06213><WTH8800>; for<WH02005> we shall sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8799> the abomination<WH08441> of the Egyptians<WH04714> to the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430>: lo, shall we sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8799> the abomination<WH08441> of the Egyptians<WH04714> before their eyes<WH05869>, and will they not stone<WH05619><WTH8799> us?

We will go<WH03212><WTH8799> three<WH07969> days<WH03117>' journey<WH01870> into the wilderness<WH04057>, and sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8804> to the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430>, as he shall command<WH0559><WTH8799> us.

And Pharaoh<WH06547> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, I will let you go<WH07971><WTH8762>, that ye may sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8804> to the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> in the wilderness<WH04057>; only ye shall not go<WH03212><WTH8800> very<WH07368><WTH8687> far away<WH07368><WTH8686>: intreat<WH06279><WTH8685> for me<WH01157>.

And Moses<WH04872> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Behold, I go out<WH03318><WTH8802> from thee, and I will intreat<WH06279><WTH8689> the LORD<WH03068> that the swarms<WH06157> <FI>of flies<Fi> may depart<WH05493><WTH8804> from Pharaoh<WH06547>, from his servants<WH05650>, and from his people<WH05971>, to morrow<WH04279>: but<WH07535> let not Pharaoh<WH06547> deal deceitfully<WH02048><WTH8763> any more<WH03254><WTH8686> in not<WH01115> letting the people<WH05971> go<WH07971><WTH8763> to sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8800> to the LORD<WH03068>.
And Moses<WH04872> went out<WH03318><WTH8799> from Pharaoh<WH06547>, and intreated<WH06279><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068>.

And the LORD<WH03068> did<WH06213><WTH8799> according to the word<WH01697> of Moses<WH04872>; and he removed<WH05493><WTH8686> the swarms<WH06157> <FI>of flies<Fi> from Pharaoh<WH06547>, from his servants<WH05650>, and from his people<WH05971>; there remained<WH07604><WTH8738> not one<WH0259>.
And Pharaoh<WH06547> hardened<WH03513><WTH8686> his heart<WH03820> at this time<WH06471> also, neither would he let the people<WH05971> go<WH07971><WTH8765>.<CM>
